title: A minimal CI workflow that calls the security gate
summary: A seed .github/workflows/ci.yml whose first and only job calls security.yml, so the gate runs on every pull request — including one that only touches Claude instruction files. The project adds its build and test jobs behind it.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

postInstall: Skip this module if the project already has a CI workflow under another file name: two workflows with the same `name:` confuse whatever waits for it. Add the call to security.yml to yours instead (docs/conventions/security-workflow.md § Wiring).
Add the project's jobs (lint, tests, build) to .github/workflows/ci.yml, each with `needs: [security]`. With no code yet, leave the TODO(harness) block as it is: the gate alone is a valid CI.
This workflow has not run in your repository yet: open one pull request that only touches CLAUDE.md and check that the CI run starts.
